title: Fluorescence sensing of metal ions in solution using a morpholine-containing phenolic Mannich base of 1′-hydroxy-2′-acetonaphthone
content:
RSC Adv., 2024, 14,38590-38604
DOI: 10.1039/D4RA07200F, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported Licence.
Andreea Laura Chibac-Scutaru, Gheorghe Roman
A phenolic Mannich base derived from 1′-hydroxy-2′-acetonaphthone 1 was synthesised. It demonstrated the ability to act as a fluorescent sensor for Al3+, exhibiting a “turn-on” response, and for Cu2+, exhibiting a “turn-off” response.
